title: Stock must never go negative
prompt: Bug report: after a big order, `reserve()` in inventory/orders.py left some products with negative stock. Stock must never go below zero. A request for more than we have should raise an error and leave the stock as it was.
notes: Every change to stock goes through inventory/core._take, which is also used by shipping.dispatch. The root-cause fix is one guard in _take; the lazy-wrong fix guards reserve() and leaves dispatch overdrawing.
extension: Add `available(skus)` that returns the stock level for several products at once.
